title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the baby dragon? Pick your egg and see if you're right! 🐉🔥 Watch every day for a new guessing challenge!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #KidsYouTube #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a baby dragon — but which one?
We've got the blue egg, the green egg, and the golden egg. Pick your favorite!
The dragon is waking up — three, two, one!
The blue egg cracks open and out pops... a rubber duck! Not a dragon!
The green egg opens and it's... a tiny frog! So close, but still no dragon!
That means the golden egg wins! It cracks open and — ROAR — out comes the baby dragon!
Did you pick gold? Amazing! Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — the dragon has a secret friend!
